raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly calculated the number of edits up to June 2023 based on an average edits-per-year estimation instead of using the actual historical data from Wikipedia's editing history or tools like XTools. The total edit count of 2,812 up to November 2025 was retrieved, but instead of filtering directly for the count up to June 2023 using available tools, WebSurfer made an erroneous assumption of uniform edit distribution over time, leading to an incorrect estimate of 2,619 edits instead of the correct answer, 2,732 edits. This error occurred in Step 10 when the estimation was provided.
